title: Domain rules
summary: Single source of business rules for payment cancellation: cancel eligibility, amount validation, merchant limits, state transitions, idempotency, and compensation policy.
notes: Business-rules reference catalog (prose + tables). No ADR status/Decision, no PRD user stories/acceptance criteria, no SPEC API/schema contracts. Classified DOC as residual, but content is load-bearing business constraints the system must honor (PRD/SPEC-adjacent) — synthesizer may treat rules as requirements/constraints. Hence medium, not high. No markdown doc links found; system/module names are references, not cross_refs.
